entity: Town-hall public-works tenders in Los Rios province, Ecuador, one-bidder share, Jan-Jun 2026 records
what_we_add: Los Rios 29 of 66 works tenders one-bidder (44%), top of 24 provinces; $13.4M of $28.8M; $6.3M in one Quevedo contract
why: CONNECTAS and Open Contracting cover one-bidder tenders across Ecuador (42.6% of processes over six years; 20.5% of open procedures by 2022). Neither names Los Rios, Quevedo or any town hall.
